approval.record: User wrote "Approve the triage thresholds" in conversation on 2026-10-09, after the thresholds were drafted by the implementing agent and presented with the ADS-051 report.
approval.scope: These ADS-051 triage-corpus thresholds on the reference stack only. Not the M5 separation_of_duties_review approval, not independent review of any packet, and not an approval of any other threshold.
approval.change_rule: Changing a threshold or the corpus digest needs a new explicit approval with a reviewed rationale and must not be bundled with a change that regresses it.

scope_note: Triage is deterministic, so agreement with hand-written labels is expected to be exact. These gates check rule behaviour and safety properties on the reference stack; they say nothing about triage quality on real user feedback.

category_agreement.measure: cases whose category equals the hand-written label

rule_agreement.measure: cases decided by the labelled rule, basis kind, and conflict flag

determinism.measure: cases whose repeated triage yields an identical decision fingerprint

undetermined_lists_candidates.measure: undetermined results that name their candidate causes

note_independence.measure: twin cases that differ only in an injected note and receive the same decision

claim_only_over_failed_runs.measure: records on non-succeeded runs decided by the reporter's claim alone

record_mutations.measure: stored triage records changed by re-triage

not_measured.real_feedback_quality: needs real user feedback and independent labelling; not available at M5 start
